lead_raw_text:
The structure of Dy₂Cu₈Ge₄ (reduced formula DyCu₄Ge₂) crystallizes in the cubic space group F-43m (No. 216), with 14 atoms per unit cell distributed over three independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis identifies tetrahedral coordination for all three elements: Dy and Ge centers each have four Cu neighbors, while Cu centers have four neighbors comprising two Dy and two Ge. The periodic neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all 14 sites, and validated polyhedron-sharing relations include corner-sharing between Cu tetrahedra and between Dy and Ge tetrahedra.
